en.title: Maximum Instructions Deleted While Keeping the Endpoint
en.description:
Unit moves UDLR are executed on an infinite plane with no obstacles. Delete any instructions, not necessarily contiguous, while keeping the final coordinates unchanged; find the maximum number of instructions that can be deleted.

The input/output protocol was compiled by this site, and missing numeric bounds are explicitly marked as site additions.
en.input: One line with an instruction string of length 1..100000, containing only U, D, L, and R.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are, in order: 4; 2; 0. These answers have been checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Keep the necessary net vertical and net horizontal displacement, and delete the remaining opposite moves in pairs.
